breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly applies the lumped-capacitance method with Bi=5 without any correction or warning. It does not flag that Bi=5 violates the small-Biot condition (Bi < 0.1), does not suggest reducing Bi to 0.05, and does not recommend using a spatially resolved transient conduction model instead. The agent repeated the original error exactly.
